scope: Narrow fixed-schema evidence collection only; no route verdict, geometry, planner or authority change.
independentReview: No blocker reported; independent reviewer and root each reran 51 collector and 31 exporter tests.
preserved: Exactly targeted per-test export; no suite-wide/all-unit attachment export.
No raw metadata values, geometry buffers, source paths, private history, camera, audio, model text or screenshots.
Metadata source inputs must match exact original public Hallway2 and Bedroom3 SHA256; node and metadata UUIDs must be source feature IDs.
Unknown metadata key/node names containing paths or non-allowlisted characters are redacted by producer; collector accepts only bounded safe names with matching SHA256 or the fixed redaction marker.
Synthetic collision contacts accept only four fixed authored UUIDs and exact control predicates; they do not verify physical clearance.
Every original case status and target verdict is retained; malformed or overbudget diagnostic is only an additive evidence error.
Original three-report shape remains compatible when new exact diagnostic cases are absent.
Export file limits, manifest validation, symlink/path checks, temporary cleanup, timeout and child process ownership remain unchanged.
limitsOfEvidence: Python tests use synthetic payloads and a bounded fake xcresulttool; no Apple SDK, RoomPlan/ModelIO or SceneKit execution on this candidate here.
Metadata inventory is a second export of the same admitted original public input, not asserted to be the identical export artifact used for adapterFailure.
Collision predicates are a literal schema-consistency mirror, not an independent physics solver or a native passing result.
No repair of unknown exporter metadata mapping is guessed; failures and no-authority flags remain explicit.
